problem.text: The change adds repository-level configuration for funding and generated-file exclusions.

reasoning.text: The ignore list targets packaging outputs, Python caches, local development files and a specifically named compiled extension rather than broadly excluding every shared library.

impact.text: This is repository housekeeping; neither changed file modifies model execution or quantization code.

limitations: Git ignore behavior and GitHub funding presentation were not exercised. These declarative settings offer no useful numerical computation to validate.

claims.text: The new .github/FUNDING.yml sets ko_fi to turboderp, supplying a funding destination without adding application logic.

The new .gitignore lists *.egg-info/, build/, *.pyc, __pycache__/, .idea, venv and dist. It also excludes exllamav3_ext.cpython-*.so, explicitly identified by a comment as produced by pip install -e .

The extension-specific pattern balances excluding local build artifacts against retaining unrelated shared libraries; its wildcard accommodates different CPython suffixes while keeping the extension name fixed.

annotation.summary: Adds Ko-fi funding metadata and ignores common Python development and build artifacts, including the editable-install native extension.
